# PersonalFin — demo

**Live demo:** https://pedrohlmonteiro.github.io/personalfin-demo/

PersonalFin is a personal-finance app I built for my own use. Account and card data come in through
[Pluggy](https://pluggy.ai) and imported spreadsheets, and the app consolidates them into a single
view of net worth and its history. The app itself is private; this page runs the real app as a single
HTML file, with its API answered from an embedded snapshot.

**All data here is fictitious**: a simulated persona generated by a fixed-seed script. No real
financial data is included.

The snapshot is regenerated daily, so the current month always has activity.
